post.description: Owner only, creator-bound review. Canonical base64 UTF-8 CSV, maximum 5 MiB / 2,000 rows / 40 columns. Standard comma delimiter, quoted newlines and doubled quotes. Mapping targetField:sourceHeader. Source-system scoped external IDs; unchanged imports skip and changed IDs conflict. Raw CSV and mapping are protected and expire after 24 hours. At most 200 errors returned, with full errorCount. Record numbers start at 2, exclude blank records and count quoted multiline content as one record.

post.description: Bind to immutable dry-run ID and SHA-256 of original file bytes. Requires current owner authorization, same creator, reviewed hash and unexpired valid batch. Revalidates references and collisions in one company-locked transaction; no partial imports. Successful replay is safe, including after expiry. Creates only draft initial jobs and unverified technician profiles backed by existing active technician memberships. No role, qualification, assignment, stock or outcome import.

get.description: Owner only. Consistent database snapshot, server asOf. Filter jobs by arrivalStart in [from,to); at most 366 days and 10,000 jobs. Initial cohort matures 14 days after max(arrivalEnd, recorded closure). Cancelled and manual exclusions removed; missing outcomes stay in denominator. Follow-ups are linked children created within the observation window. Preparation is elapsed creation-to-first-approval across all approved jobs in range, not active labor. Current gaps check up to 200 eligible unassigned jobs in stable ID order; unevaluated count disclosed. Null rates for empty cohorts; descriptive associations only.
